title: SearchEventsRequest
description: Request schema for the search_events tool.

startDateFrom.description: Optional lower bound filter. Includes events starting on or after this date/time. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ).

startDateTo.description: Optional upper bound filter. Includes events starting on or before this date/time. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ).

places.description: Optional list of place label; can be empty.

artists.description: Optional list of artist label; can be empty.

organizations.description: Optional list of organization label; can be empty.

types.description: Optional list of event type label; can be empty.
